title: 疼痛醫學
intro: 本科程序庫涵蓋疼痛評估與分類（傷害性、神經病變性、傷害可塑性）、急性術後疼痛與多模式止痛、病人自控式止痛、慢性下背痛與坐骨神經痛的分層照護、神經病變性疼痛、癌症疼痛與階梯、鴉片類藥物的管理與減量、頭痛與偏頭痛、複雜性區域疼痛症候群、纖維肌痛、介入治療的安全（硬膜外與神經根注射、小面關節與射頻、交感神經阻斷、脊髓刺激器）、心理與復健整合、安寧與交班。
introEn: This library covers pain assessment and classification (nociceptive, neuropathic, nociplastic), acute postoperative pain and multimodal analgesia, patient-controlled analgesia, stratified care for chronic low back pain and sciatica, neuropathic pain, cancer pain and the analgesic ladder, opioid stewardship and tapering, headache and migraine, complex regional pain syndrome, fibromyalgia, safety of interventions (epidural and root injections, facet and radiofrequency, sympathetic blocks, spinal cord stimulation), psychological and rehabilitation integration, palliative care and handover.

procedures.title: 疼痛門診首次評估：量表、紅黃旗與機制分類
procedures.titleEn: First pain-clinic assessment: scales, red and yellow flags and mechanism classification
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：52 歲女性，右頸肩痛八個月，夜間痛醒，近月出現手指麻刺。疼痛科主治、專科護理師與物理治療師共同進行首次評估。本單元教疼痛工具、紅黃旗與傷害性／神經病變性／傷害可塑性分類；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 52-year-old woman with eight months of right neck and shoulder pain that wakes her at night, and recent tingling in the fingers. The pain attending, nurse specialist and physiotherapist perform the first assessment together. Teaches pain tools, red and yellow flags and nociceptive, neuropathic and nociplastic classification; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 開場的問題
stages.evidence: 病人說「痛 10 分，一直都痛」；住院醫師在病歷寫下 10/10 就要往下走。
stages.evidenceEn: She says the pain is 10 out of 10 all the time; the resident writes 10/10 and moves on.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 記錄 10/10，下次回診再比較分數變化
choices.en: Record 10/10 and compare the score at the next visit

choices.zh: 以 SOCRATES 詢問性質、時間與誘因
choices.en: Unpack it with SOCRATES: character, timing, triggers

choices.zh: 先安排頸椎 MRI 找出結構病因
choices.en: Order a cervical MRI to find the structural cause

stages.reason: 單一數字無法分類機制；疼痛的性質、放射與日夜型態才指向病因。
stages.reasonEn: A single number cannot classify the mechanism; character, radiation and the day-night pattern point to the cause.
stages.pitfall: 若只記數字：神經根病變被當肌肉痛，物理治療三個月無效。
stages.pitfallEn: Recording only the number treats a radiculopathy as muscle pain and wastes three months of physiotherapy.

stages.title: 量表的選擇
stages.evidence: 專科護理師問：門診只用 NRS 追蹤夠不夠？
stages.evidenceEn: The nurse specialist asks whether tracking with NRS alone is enough in clinic.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 只用 NRS，每次回診記錄強度
choices.en: NRS alone, recording intensity at each visit

choices.zh: 以病人整體滿意度作為主要指標
choices.en: Use overall satisfaction as the main measure

choices.zh: NRS 加 PEG 功能量表
choices.en: NRS plus a function scale such as PEG

stages.reason: 慢性疼痛的治療目標是功能與生活品質；PEG 三題同時追蹤強度、享受與活動。
stages.reasonEn: Chronic pain is treated for function and quality of life; the three PEG items track intensity, enjoyment and general activity together.
stages.pitfall: 若只看強度：功能明顯改善卻因分數沒變被判定治療失敗。
stages.pitfallEn: Watching intensity alone labels a treatment a failure while function has clearly improved.

stages.title: 紅旗
stages.evidence: 夜間痛醒、三個月瘦四公斤、五年前乳癌病史。
stages.evidenceEn: Night pain, four kilograms lost in three months, breast cancer five years ago.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 紅旗：需影像與檢驗排除轉移
choices.en: Red flags: image and test to exclude metastasis

choices.zh: 更年期荷爾蒙變化所致，先觀察
choices.en: Menopausal hormonal change; observe first

choices.zh: 壓力與失眠造成的體重下降
choices.en: Weight loss from stress and poor sleep

stages.reason: 癌症病史、非機械性夜間痛與體重減輕是脊椎轉移的紅旗組合。
stages.reasonEn: A cancer history, non-mechanical night pain and weight loss form the red-flag triad for spinal metastasis.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：頸椎轉移在物理治療中進展為脊髓壓迫。
stages.pitfallEn: Missed, a cervical metastasis progresses to cord compression during physiotherapy.

stages.title: 黃旗
stages.evidence: 她說「我怕一動會更糟」，已請假三個月，對主管不滿。
stages.evidenceEn: She says she is afraid movement will make it worse, has been off work three months and resents her manager.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 與疼痛無關的職場問題，另行轉介
choices.en: Workplace issues unrelated to pain; refer separately

choices.zh: 慢性化黃旗，需早期心理社會介入
choices.en: Yellow flags for chronicity; start psychosocial care early

choices.zh: 顯示疼痛主要是心理因素造成
choices.en: Shows the pain is mainly psychological in origin

stages.reason: 黃旗預測失能與慢性化；辨識不是否定疼痛，而是把心理社會介入提早。
stages.reasonEn: Yellow flags predict disability and chronicity; naming them does not deny the pain, it brings psychosocial care forward.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：三個月後失業、憂鬱，疼痛變得更難治。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored, she is unemployed and depressed three months later and the pain is harder to treat.

stages.title: 神經學檢查
stages.evidence: C6 皮節感覺減退、肱二頭肌反射減弱、Spurling 試驗陽性。
stages.evidenceEn: Reduced sensation in the C6 dermatome, diminished biceps reflex, positive Spurling's test.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 旋轉肌袖病變合併轉移痛
choices.en: Rotator cuff disease with referred pain

choices.zh: 腕隧道症候群壓迫正中神經
choices.en: Carpal tunnel syndrome compressing the median nerve

choices.zh: C6 頸神經根病變
choices.en: A C6 cervical nerve-root radiculopathy

stages.reason: 皮節、反射與誘發試驗三者一致才能定位神經根；肩與腕病變不會改變反射。
stages.reasonEn: Dermatome, reflex and provocation test agree to localise the root; shoulder and wrist disease do not alter reflexes.
stages.pitfall: 若定位錯誤：病人接受不必要的肩關節注射。
stages.pitfallEn: Mislocalised, she receives an unnecessary shoulder injection.

stages.title: 機制分類
stages.evidence: DN4 得 6 分；同時有頸部活動時的機械性酸痛。
stages.evidenceEn: DN4 scores 6; she also has mechanical aching on neck movement.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 混合型：神經病變性加傷害性
choices.en: Mixed: neuropathic plus nociceptive

choices.zh: 純傷害性，DN4 分數受焦慮影響
choices.en: Purely nociceptive; DN4 inflated by anxiety

choices.zh: 傷害可塑性，屬中樞敏感化
choices.en: Nociplastic, from central sensitisation

stages.reason: DN4 四分以上提示神經病變性成分；機械性酸痛來自關節與肌肉的傷害性輸入，兩者常並存。
stages.reasonEn: DN4 of 4 or more suggests a neuropathic component; mechanical aching is nociceptive input from joints and muscle, and the two often coexist.
stages.pitfall: 若只治一種機制：另一半疼痛被留下，病人以為治療無效。
stages.pitfallEn: Treating one mechanism leaves half the pain behind and the patient concludes nothing works.

stages.title: 另一位病人
stages.evidence: 下一位：全身廣泛痛、疲倦、睡不好、腦霧；檢查與檢驗皆無異常。
stages.evidenceEn: Next patient: widespread pain, fatigue, poor sleep, brain fog; examination and tests normal.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 檢查正常，應懷疑裝病或次級獲益
choices.en: Normal tests suggest malingering or secondary gain

choices.zh: 傷害可塑性疼痛（中樞敏感化）
choices.en: Nociplastic pain with central sensitisation

choices.zh: 憂鬱症的身體化，非真正疼痛
choices.en: Somatised depression rather than real pain

stages.reason: IASP 第三類機制：無組織損傷或神經病變證據，卻有疼痛處理改變的證據。
stages.reasonEn: The third IASP mechanism: no evidence of tissue damage or neuropathy, but evidence of altered pain processing.
stages.pitfall: 若當成找不到病因：反覆檢查、重複影像、病人被貼上標籤。
stages.pitfallEn: Treated as an undiagnosed mystery, she gets repeated tests and imaging and a label.

stages.title: 影像決策
stages.evidence: 住院醫師為兩位病人都開了全脊椎 MRI。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident orders whole-spine MRI for both patients.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 兩位都做全脊椎 MRI 以免遺漏
choices.en: Whole-spine MRI for both to miss nothing

choices.zh: 兩位都先觀察六週再決定影像
choices.en: Watch both for six weeks before imaging

choices.zh: 第一位做全脊椎，第二位不需影像
choices.en: Whole-spine MRI for the first; no imaging for the second

stages.reason: 疑脊椎轉移應做全脊椎 MRI；傷害可塑性疼痛的影像只會找到無關的退化。
stages.reasonEn: Suspected spinal metastasis needs whole-spine MRI; in nociplastic pain imaging only finds unrelated degeneration.
stages.pitfall: 若全做：偶然發現的椎間盤膨出讓第二位病人深信脊椎「壞了」。
stages.pitfallEn: Imaging everyone shows an incidental bulge that convinces the second patient her spine is broken.

stages.title: 共同目標
stages.evidence: 病人說目標是「完全不痛」。
stages.evidenceEn: She says her goal is zero pain.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 改寫為可測量的功能目標
choices.en: Reframe as measurable function goals

choices.zh: 承諾逐步調藥直到完全不痛
choices.en: Promise to adjust drugs until she is pain-free

choices.zh: 直接告知慢性痛不可能改善
choices.en: Tell her plainly chronic pain cannot improve

stages.reason: 慢性疼痛的實際目標是功能；SMART 目標讓每次回診有可比較的基準。
stages.reasonEn: Realistic chronic-pain goals are functional; SMART goals give each visit a comparable baseline.
stages.pitfall: 若承諾零痛：第一次治療未達標即失去信任。
stages.pitfallEn: Promising zero pain loses her trust the first time a treatment falls short.

stages.title: 治療計畫
stages.evidence: 主治請團隊提出整合計畫。
stages.evidenceEn: The attending asks the team for an integrated plan.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 先給止痛藥，等 MRI 結果再決定
choices.en: Analgesics first; decide after the MRI result

choices.zh: 復健、神經病變藥物與心理介入並行
choices.en: Physio, neuropathic drugs and psychology in parallel

choices.zh: 有神經根病變，直接轉介脊椎外科手術
choices.en: Radiculopathy present; refer straight for spinal surgery

stages.reason: 多專業並行比序貫等待更快改善功能；手術只在進行性缺損或保守治療失敗時考慮。
stages.reasonEn: Parallel multidisciplinary care restores function faster than sequential waiting; surgery is for progressive deficit or failed conservative care.
stages.pitfall: 若只開藥：三個月後藥越吃越多，功能卻沒變。
stages.pitfallEn: Medication alone leaves her on more tablets and the same function three months later.

stages.title: 追蹤與交班
stages.evidence: 轉介信要寄給家庭醫師；住院醫師只寫「頸痛，已開藥」。
stages.evidenceEn: The referral letter to the family doctor reads only neck pain, medication started.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 寫「頸痛，已開藥」，細節見處方
choices.en: Write 'neck pain, medication started'; see prescription

choices.zh: 附上 MRI 報告與影像光碟，由家醫判讀
choices.en: Attach the MRI report and disc for the GP to interpret

choices.zh: 寫明機制、紅黃旗、基線、目標與計畫
choices.en: State mechanism, flags, baselines, goals and plan

stages.reason: 交班是下一位照護者的起點；基線與目標讓每一位接手者都能判斷進展。
stages.reasonEn: Handover is the next carer's starting point; baselines and goals let anyone who takes over judge progress.
stages.pitfall: 若交班空洞：家醫重新開藥，計畫在兩個門診之間消失。
stages.pitfallEn: A hollow handover makes the family doctor restart medication and the plan vanishes between clinics.

procedures.title: 急性術後疼痛與多模式止痛
procedures.titleEn: Acute postoperative pain and multimodal analgesia
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：68 歲男性，腹腔鏡結腸切除術後第一天，術前已長期服用鴉片類止痛背痛。急性疼痛服務主治、急性疼痛護理師、病房護理師與藥師共同照護。本單元教多模式原則、禁忌辨識與鎮靜監測，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 68-year-old man on day one after laparoscopic colectomy, already on long-term opioids for back pain before surgery. The acute pain service attending, acute pain nurse, ward nurse and pharmacist care for him. Teaches multimodal principles, contraindication recognition and sedation monitoring, without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 術前的長期鴉片類
stages.evidence: 住院醫師建議術後把他平日的鴉片類全部停掉，「反正有 PCA」。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident proposes stopping all his usual opioids after surgery because he will have a PCA.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 術後全部停用，以免累加造成呼吸抑制
choices.en: Stop them all to avoid additive respiratory depression

choices.zh: 維持平日劑量，加多模式與區域
choices.en: Keep his usual opioid; add multimodal and regional care

choices.zh: 停用口服，改以 PCA 按需取代
choices.en: Stop oral opioids and replace them with PCA on demand

stages.reason: 長期使用者有耐受性；停掉基礎用量會造成戒斷，PCA 也追不上需求。
stages.reasonEn: Long-term users are tolerant; stopping the baseline causes withdrawal and the PCA cannot keep up.
stages.pitfall: 若停藥：術後第一夜出汗、焦躁、疼痛失控，被誤認為譫妄。
stages.pitfallEn: Stopped, he spends the first night sweating and agitated with uncontrolled pain, mistaken for delirium.

stages.title: 多模式原則
stages.evidence: 處方上只有一種強效鴉片類；藥師來電詢問。
stages.evidenceEn: The chart shows a single strong opioid; the pharmacist calls.
stages.question: 這一步的主要理由是？
stages.questionEn: What is the main reason for this step?

choices.zh: 單一鴉片類較易調整與監測
choices.en: A single opioid is easier to titrate and monitor

choices.zh: 多模式增加交互作用，應避免
choices.en: Multimodal care adds interactions; avoid it

choices.zh: 多模式組合，鴉片類作補救
choices.en: Multimodal combination; opioids only as rescue

stages.reason: 不同機制的藥物與區域技術相加，可減少鴉片類用量與其副作用。
stages.reasonEn: Agents with different mechanisms plus regional techniques add up, cutting opioid requirement and side effects.
stages.pitfall: 若單用鴉片類：腸麻痺延長、噁心、鎮靜，住院多住三天。
stages.pitfallEn: Opioid-only analgesia prolongs ileus, adds nausea and sedation and keeps him in three days longer.

stages.title: NSAID 的禁忌
stages.evidence: 藥師指出：eGFR 偏低、兩年前消化道出血、正在用抗凝劑。
stages.evidenceEn: The pharmacist notes a low eGFR, a gastrointestinal bleed two years ago and current anticoagulation.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 不用 NSAID，改其他非鴉片類
choices.en: No NSAIDs; build on other non-opioid agents

choices.zh: 短期低劑量 NSAID 仍可安全使用
choices.en: A short low-dose NSAID course is still safe

choices.zh: 併用質子幫浦抑制劑即可使用 NSAID
choices.en: NSAIDs are fine with a proton-pump inhibitor

stages.reason: 腎功能不良、出血史與抗凝是 NSAID 的主要禁忌；多模式不等於每種都用。
stages.reasonEn: Renal impairment, bleeding history and anticoagulation are the main NSAID contraindications; multimodal does not mean everything.
stages.pitfall: 若照用：術後第三天急性腎損傷與吻合口出血。
stages.pitfallEn: Used anyway, day three brings acute kidney injury and anastomotic bleeding.

stages.title: 區域技術
stages.evidence: 麻醉科問腹腔鏡手術適合哪種區域技術。
stages.evidenceEn: The anaesthetist asks which regional technique suits laparoscopic surgery.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 以胸椎硬膜外為標準，一律放置
choices.en: Thoracic epidural as standard for everyone

choices.zh: 腹壁平面阻斷或傷口局部浸潤
choices.en: Abdominal-wall plane block or wound infiltration

choices.zh: 腹腔鏡切口小，不需區域技術
choices.en: Small laparoscopic incisions need no regional technique

stages.reason: 腹腔鏡的切口痛以腹壁為主；平面阻斷與浸潤在加速康復路徑中比硬膜外更少低血壓與延遲活動。
stages.reasonEn: Laparoscopic incisional pain is mainly abdominal-wall; plane blocks and infiltration give less hypotension and delayed mobilisation than epidurals within enhanced recovery.
stages.pitfall: 若一律硬膜外：低血壓、導尿管延長，病人躺著不動。
stages.pitfallEn: Routine epidurals cause hypotension, prolonged catheters and an immobile patient.

stages.title: 第一天的評估
stages.evidence: 護理師記錄 NRS 3；你問他咳嗽時幾分，他說 8。
stages.evidenceEn: The nurse records NRS 3; you ask about coughing and he says 8.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 休息痛 3 分，已達止痛目標
choices.en: Rest pain of 3 meets the target

choices.zh: 8 分代表止痛完全失敗，需換藥
choices.en: 8 means analgesia has failed; change drugs

choices.zh: 應以咳嗽時的動態痛為準
choices.en: Dynamic pain on coughing is what counts

stages.reason: 休息痛與活動痛必須分開記錄；活動痛控制不良導致肺塌陷與靜脈栓塞。
stages.reasonEn: Rest and movement pain must be recorded separately; poor dynamic analgesia causes atelectasis and venous thrombosis.
stages.pitfall: 若只看休息痛：第三天肺炎，病人不敢下床。
stages.pitfallEn: Watching rest pain alone ends in pneumonia on day three and a patient afraid to stand.

stages.title: 鎮靜分數
stages.evidence: NRS 7，但病人說話中途睡著；POSS 3。
stages.evidenceEn: NRS 7, but he drifts off mid-sentence; POSS 3.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 暫停鴉片類，鎮靜先於呼吸抑制
choices.en: Hold opioids; sedation precedes respiratory depression

choices.zh: 疼痛仍有 7 分，追加一劑並再評估
choices.en: Pain is still 7; give another dose and reassess

choices.zh: 讓他睡，入睡代表止痛已經足夠
choices.en: Let him sleep; sleep means analgesia is adequate

stages.reason: 鎮靜程度比呼吸速率更早反映鴉片類過量；疼痛分數高不代表能再給。
stages.reasonEn: Sedation reflects opioid excess earlier than respiratory rate; a high pain score does not license another dose.
stages.pitfall: 若再給：兩小時後呼吸 6 次，急救團隊到場。
stages.pitfallEn: Another dose brings a respiratory rate of 6 two hours later and the crash team.

stages.title: 噁心與便秘
stages.evidence: 病人噁心，三天未排便；護理師問要不要等有症狀再處理便秘。
stages.evidenceEn: He is nauseated and has not opened his bowels for three days; the nurse asks whether to wait on the constipation.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 先觀察，有便秘症狀再開軟便劑
choices.en: Watch first; start a laxative once constipated

choices.zh: 止吐並預防性開始軟便劑
choices.en: Antiemetic plus a prophylactic laxative now

choices.zh: 停掉所有止痛藥直到排便
choices.en: Stop all analgesia until he opens his bowels

stages.reason: 鴉片類便秘不會耐受；預防性處理比治療容易，也避免腸麻痺被誤判。
stages.reasonEn: Opioid constipation does not wear off; prevention is easier than treatment and avoids confusion with ileus.
stages.pitfall: 若等待：糞便阻塞、腹脹、嘔吐，被懷疑吻合口漏而做 CT。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting leads to impaction, distension and vomiting, and a CT for suspected anastomotic leak.

stages.title: 搔癢
stages.evidence: 脊椎內鴉片類後全身搔癢；住院醫師開抗組織胺。
stages.evidenceEn: Generalised itching after neuraxial opioid; the resident prescribes an antihistamine.
stages.question: 最可能的原因是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most likely cause?

choices.zh: 組織胺釋放所致，加開抗組織胺即可
choices.en: Histamine release; an antihistamine will settle it

choices.zh: 藥物過敏，應停用所有鴉片類
choices.en: Drug allergy; stop all opioids

choices.zh: μ 受體效應，可用低劑量拮抗劑
choices.en: A mu-receptor effect; a low-dose antagonist can help

stages.reason: 脊椎內鴉片類搔癢是中樞 μ 受體效應，不是過敏；抗組織胺只提供鎮靜。
stages.reasonEn: Neuraxial opioid itch is a central mu-receptor effect, not allergy; antihistamines add only sedation.
stages.pitfall: 若用抗組織胺：鎮靜加重，搔癢不變。
stages.pitfallEn: Antihistamines deepen sedation and leave the itch untouched.

stages.title: 老年人的原則
stages.evidence: 隔床 82 歲女性同樣手術；住院醫師照抄同樣處方。
stages.evidenceEn: The 82-year-old in the next bed had the same operation; the resident copies the same chart.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 低起始、慢增量、密集監測
choices.en: Start low, go slow, monitor closely

choices.zh: 照抄相同處方，術後疼痛相近
choices.en: Copy the same orders; the pain will be similar

choices.zh: 高齡易譫妄，盡量少給止痛藥
choices.en: Elderly patients get delirium; minimise analgesia

stages.reason: 老年人腎清除率與中樞敏感性改變；疼痛治療不足與過量都造成譫妄。
stages.reasonEn: Age alters renal clearance and central sensitivity; both undertreated pain and overdose cause delirium.
stages.pitfall: 若照抄：隔天早上老太太嗜睡、尿滯留與譫妄。
stages.pitfallEn: Copied, the chart leaves her drowsy, in retention and delirious by morning.

stages.title: 出院處方
stages.evidence: 住院醫師準備開 30 天強效鴉片類帶回家。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident is about to prescribe 30 days of strong opioid to take home.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 開 30 天份，避免出院後疼痛復發
choices.en: Thirty days so pain does not return at home

choices.zh: 短期少量，附停藥與剩藥處理
choices.en: Short, small supply with stop and disposal plan

choices.zh: 出院不開任何止痛，避免成癮
choices.en: No analgesics at discharge to prevent addiction

stages.reason: 術後鴉片類應在數天內遞減；多餘藥物是家庭中誤用的來源。
stages.reasonEn: Postoperative opioids should taper over days; leftover tablets are a source of household misuse.
stages.pitfall: 若給 30 天：三個月後病人仍在服用，成了新的長期使用者。
stages.pitfallEn: A 30-day supply leaves him still taking it three months later, a new long-term user.

stages.title: 交班
stages.evidence: 病房轉出到一般病房，急性疼痛護理師準備交班。
stages.evidenceEn: He moves to a general ward; the acute pain nurse prepares the handover.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 交班方案、鎮靜分數與停藥計畫
choices.en: Hand over regimen, sedation scores and taper plan

choices.zh: 只交班最近一次 NRS 分數
choices.en: Hand over only the latest NRS score

choices.zh: 轉床沿用原醫囑，不需另外交班
choices.en: Orders carry over; no separate handover needed

stages.reason: 止痛方案的風險在交接時最高；明確的鎮靜監測與停藥計畫讓新病房延續安全。
stages.reasonEn: Analgesic plans are most dangerous at transitions; explicit sedation monitoring and a taper plan carry safety to the new ward.
stages.pitfall: 若交班不完整：新病房同時給兩種鴉片類。
stages.pitfallEn: An incomplete handover has the new ward giving two opioids at once.

procedures.title: 病人自控式止痛（PCA）設置與監測
procedures.titleEn: Patient-controlled analgesia set-up and monitoring
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：45 歲女性，開放性子宮肌瘤切除術後，計畫靜脈 PCA。急性疼痛護理師、麻醉科主治、病房護理師與藥師共同設置與監測。本單元教篩選、雙人核對、管路安全與鎮靜監測，不含藥物劑量或輸注速率；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 45-year-old woman after open myomectomy, planned for intravenous PCA. The acute pain nurse, anaesthetist, ward nurse and pharmacist set up and monitor it. Teaches patient selection, two-person checks, line safety and sedation monitoring, without doses or infusion rates; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 病人的擔心
stages.evidence: 術前訪視時她說：「我怕按太多會上癮。」
stages.evidenceEn: At the preoperative visit she says she is afraid pressing too often will make her addicted.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 提醒她盡量忍耐，少按幾次
choices.en: Ask her to tolerate it and press sparingly

choices.zh: 改成護理師定時給藥，避免她上癮
choices.en: Switch to scheduled nurse doses to prevent addiction

choices.zh: 解釋鎖定設計，鼓勵痛前就按
choices.en: Explain the lockout; press before pain peaks

stages.reason: PCA 的安全來自鎖定時間與病人必須清醒才能按；教育決定它是否有效。
stages.reasonEn: PCA safety comes from the lockout and from the patient having to be awake to press; education decides whether it works.
stages.pitfall: 若未教育：病人忍到痛不可忍才按，分數在 2 與 9 之間震盪。
stages.pitfallEn: Uneducated, she waits until the pain is unbearable and her scores swing between 2 and 9.

stages.title: 不適合的病人
stages.evidence: 另一位病人嚴重失智、無法理解按鈕。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient has advanced dementia and cannot understand the button.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 不適合 PCA，改護理師給藥
choices.en: Unsuitable for PCA; use nurse-given doses

choices.zh: 由陪伴的家屬在她痛時代為按鈕
choices.en: Let the family press the button when she hurts

choices.zh: 照常使用，並加上持續背景輸注
choices.en: Use it anyway with a background infusion

stages.reason: PCA 要求病人理解按鈕與疼痛的關係；無法理解者既得不到止痛，也失去安全機制。
stages.reasonEn: PCA requires understanding the button-pain link; without it the patient gets neither analgesia nor the safety mechanism.
stages.pitfall: 若照常用：病人整夜未按、疼痛失控，隔天護理師代按造成過量。
stages.pitfallEn: Used anyway, she never presses overnight, then a nurse presses for her and overdoses her.

stages.title: 雙人核對
stages.evidence: 處方寫的藥名與濃度和幫浦程式顯示不同。
stages.evidenceEn: The drug and concentration on the prescription differ from what the pump displays.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 先開始輸注，稍後再請藥局更正
choices.en: Start now and ask pharmacy to correct it later

choices.zh: 暫停，雙人核對處方、藥袋與程式
choices.en: Stop; two people check order, bag and programme

choices.zh: 以幫浦內建程式為準，回頭修改處方
choices.en: Trust the pump programme and amend the prescription

stages.reason: 濃度錯誤是 PCA 最常見的嚴重事件；三者一致才允許連接病人。
stages.reasonEn: Concentration errors are the commonest serious PCA incident; prescription, label and programme must agree before connection.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：十倍濃度錯誤在第一小時造成呼吸停止。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored, a tenfold concentration error stops her breathing within the first hour.

stages.title: 管路
stages.evidence: 護理師把 PCA 接在主輸液線上，沒有抗回流閥。
stages.evidenceEn: The nurse connects the PCA to the main infusion line without an anti-reflux valve.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 必須有抗回流閥與專用接口
choices.en: Anti-reflux valve and dedicated port are mandatory

choices.zh: 主線通暢時不需抗回流閥
choices.en: No valve needed while the main line runs freely

choices.zh: 接在主線並調快主線流速
choices.en: Keep it on the main line and run that line faster

stages.reason: 主線阻塞時藥物會逆流進輸液袋，阻塞解除後一次灌入。
stages.reasonEn: If the main line occludes, drug refluxes into the fluid bag and floods in when the occlusion clears.
stages.pitfall: 若無閥：病人換姿勢後突然嗜睡，原因找了半小時。
stages.pitfallEn: Without the valve she becomes suddenly drowsy after turning over, and it takes half an hour to find out why.

stages.title: 監測計畫
stages.evidence: 病房護理師問：多久看一次、看什麼？
stages.evidenceEn: The ward nurse asks how often to check and what to record.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 持續 SpO2 監測，警報響再處理
choices.en: Continuous oximetry; act when the alarm sounds

choices.zh: 每班評估疼痛分數，痛就給藥
choices.en: Pain score each shift; give a dose if in pain

choices.zh: 定時評估鎮靜、呼吸、血氧與疼痛
choices.en: Scheduled sedation, breathing, oximetry and pain checks

stages.reason: 鎮靜分數是最早的警訊；血氧在吸氧的病人會延遲下降。
stages.reasonEn: Sedation score is the earliest warning; oximetry lags in a patient on supplemental oxygen.
stages.pitfall: 若只看 SpO2：吸氧下數值正常，直到呼吸停止。
stages.pitfallEn: Watching oximetry alone on oxygen shows normal numbers until breathing stops.

stages.title: 夜間的發現
stages.evidence: 凌晨兩點：POSS 3、呼吸 8 次／分、叫得醒但立刻睡去。
stages.evidenceEn: Two in the morning: POSS 3, respiratory rate 8, rousable but drifts straight back off.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 記錄生命徵象，三十分鐘後再評估一次
choices.en: Record vital signs and reassess in thirty minutes

choices.zh: 停 PCA、刺激給氧、備拮抗劑並求援
choices.en: Stop PCA, stimulate, oxygen, antagonist ready, call help

choices.zh: 調低 PCA 設定並加強鼻導管氧氣
choices.en: Turn the PCA down and increase nasal oxygen

stages.reason: 呼吸抑制在深度鎮靜之後接著出現；拔掉按鈕、刺激與呼叫同時進行。
stages.reasonEn: Respiratory depression follows deep sedation; removing the button, stimulating and calling happen together.
stages.pitfall: 若觀察：半小時後呼吸 4 次，需要袋瓣面罩。
stages.pitfallEn: Observed, she is breathing four times a minute half an hour later and needs bag-mask ventilation.

stages.title: 「按了沒效」
stages.evidence: 病人說按很多次沒用；幫浦顯示需求 40 次、給藥 10 次。
stages.evidenceEn: She says pressing does nothing; the pump shows 40 demands and 10 deliveries.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 幫浦故障，立即更換新幫浦
choices.en: Pump fault; replace the pump now

choices.zh: 她過度按壓，有成癮傾向
choices.en: She over-presses and is showing addiction

choices.zh: 止痛不足：先找新疼痛原因
choices.en: Inadequate analgesia: look for a new cause first

stages.reason: 需求／給藥比例高代表止痛不足；新發劇痛要先排除併發症，再考慮調整處方。
stages.reasonEn: A high demand-to-delivery ratio means inadequate analgesia; new severe pain must exclude a complication before the prescription changes.
stages.pitfall: 若直接加藥：腹腔內出血被鴉片類蓋住到休克。
stages.pitfallEn: Increasing the drug masks an intra-abdominal bleed until she is shocked.

stages.title: 代按
stages.evidence: 你看見丈夫在她睡著時替她按鈕。
stages.evidenceEn: You see her husband pressing the button while she sleeps.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 代按繞過安全機制，制止並衛教
choices.en: Proxy pressing bypasses safety; stop and educate

choices.zh: 出於善意，只要她不痛就可以
choices.en: It is well-meant; fine if it keeps her comfortable

choices.zh: 改為持續輸注，家屬就不必代按
choices.en: Switch to a continuous infusion so he need not press

stages.reason: 病人睡著就不會按，是 PCA 的內建保護；代按等於移除保護。
stages.reasonEn: A sleeping patient does not press; that is PCA's built-in protection, and proxy pressing removes it.
stages.pitfall: 若放任：鎮靜加深，隔天早上呼吸抑制。
stages.pitfallEn: Left alone, sedation deepens and she is in respiratory depression by morning.

stages.title: 轉換
stages.evidence: 第二天她能進食，需求次數少。
stages.evidenceEn: Day two: she is eating and pressing little.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 再留三天，確保疼痛穩定再停
choices.en: Keep it three more days until pain is stable

choices.zh: 停 PCA，轉口服多模式
choices.en: Stop the PCA; switch to oral multimodal analgesia

choices.zh: 停 PCA 及所有止痛藥，觀察即可
choices.en: Stop the PCA and all analgesia and observe

stages.reason: 能口服即轉口服；PCA 留太久延後活動、增加管路與感染風險。
stages.reasonEn: Convert as soon as she can swallow; a lingering PCA delays mobilisation and adds line and infection risk.
stages.pitfall: 若多留：導管感染與不必要的住院日。
stages.pitfallEn: Left in, the line becomes infected and adds hospital days.

stages.title: 交班
stages.evidence: 日班護理師接手；夜班只說「PCA 中」。
stages.evidenceEn: Day shift takes over; night shift says only PCA running.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 寫「PCA 中」已足夠，數據可在系統查
choices.en: 'On PCA' is enough; the data are in the system

choices.zh: 交班用量、鎮靜趨勢、副作用與計畫
choices.en: Hand over use, sedation trend, side effects, plan

choices.zh: 交班幫浦型號與藥袋剩餘量
choices.en: Hand over the pump model and remaining volume

stages.reason: 趨勢比單點數值重要；交班是檢查代按、管路與鎮靜的第二雙眼睛。
stages.reasonEn: Trends matter more than single values; handover is a second pair of eyes on proxy pressing, lines and sedation.
stages.pitfall: 若交班空洞：日班不知道夜裡曾嗜睡，再次發生。
stages.pitfallEn: A hollow handover hides last night's drowsiness and it happens again.

procedures.title: 病房鴉片類呼吸抑制：辨識、拮抗與原因分析
procedures.titleEn: Opioid-induced respiratory depression on the ward: recognition, reversal and root cause
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：74 歲男性，髖關節置換術後第二天，夜間護理師發現叫不醒、呼吸每分鐘六次。病房護理師、值班醫師、急性疼痛護理師與麻醉科主治投入。本單元教辨識、團隊急救、拮抗劑的原則與系統性原因分析，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 74-year-old man two days after hip replacement, found unrousable at night with a respiratory rate of six. The ward nurse, on-call doctor, acute pain nurse and anaesthetist respond. Teaches recognition, team resuscitation, antagonist principles and root-cause analysis, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 「他睡得很熟」
stages.evidence: 護理師說他睡得很熟；你看到呼吸 6 次、針尖瞳孔、SpO2 86%。
stages.evidenceEn: The nurse says he is sleeping deeply; you see a rate of 6, pinpoint pupils and SpO2 86%.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 術後疲倦的正常深睡，不要叫醒
choices.en: Normal deep postoperative sleep; let him rest

choices.zh: 鴉片類過量造成呼吸抑制
choices.en: Opioid overdose causing respiratory depression

choices.zh: 急性腦中風，需啟動中風小組
choices.en: Acute stroke; activate the stroke team

stages.reason: 鎮靜、呼吸速率下降與針尖瞳孔是鴉片類過量的三聯徵。
stages.reasonEn: Sedation, a falling respiratory rate and pinpoint pupils form the opioid-overdose triad.
stages.pitfall: 若當作睡眠：下一次巡房時已無呼吸。
stages.pitfallEn: Called sleep, he has stopped breathing by the next round.

stages.title: 呼叫
stages.evidence: 值班醫師想先自己處理再說。
stages.evidenceEn: The on-call doctor wants to manage it alone first.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 立即求援並停所有鴉片與鎮靜藥
choices.en: Call for help now; stop all opioids and sedatives

choices.zh: 先自行處理，穩定後再呼叫
choices.en: Manage it yourself; call once stable

choices.zh: 先停 PCA，等麻醉科回電再決定
choices.en: Stop the PCA and wait for anaesthesia to call back

stages.reason: 呼吸抑制可在數分鐘內變成心跳停止；人力與停藥是同一個動作。
stages.reasonEn: Respiratory depression becomes cardiac arrest within minutes; summoning hands and stopping the drugs are one action.
stages.pitfall: 若延後呼叫：單人無法同時維持氣道與給藥。
stages.pitfallEn: Delayed, one person cannot hold the airway and give drugs at the same time.

stages.title: 氣道
stages.evidence: 打鼾聲、胸廓起伏微弱、SpO2 持續下降。
stages.evidenceEn: Snoring, feeble chest movement, SpO2 still falling.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 鼻導管給氧，觀察血氧回升
choices.en: Nasal oxygen and watch the saturation recover

choices.zh: 先推拮抗劑，等它生效再處理氣道
choices.en: Give the antagonist; manage the airway once it works

choices.zh: 打開氣道、給氧，必要時面罩通氣
choices.en: Open the airway, oxygen, bag-mask if needed

stages.reason: 拮抗劑需要時間；氧合與通氣先於藥物。
stages.reasonEn: The antagonist takes time; oxygenation and ventilation come before any drug.
stages.pitfall: 若等待：缺氧性腦損傷在拮抗劑生效前發生。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting lets hypoxic brain injury happen before the antagonist acts.

stages.title: 拮抗劑
stages.evidence: 住院醫師抽好整支拮抗劑準備一次推完。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident draws up a full ampoule of antagonist to push at once.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 整支一次推完，最快逆轉
choices.en: Push the whole syringe for the fastest reversal

choices.zh: 小量分次滴定至呼吸恢復
choices.en: Small titrated increments until breathing recovers

choices.zh: 仍有呼吸，先給氧觀察不需拮抗
choices.en: He is breathing; oxygen and observe, no antagonist

stages.reason: 目標是恢復呼吸而非清醒；完全逆轉造成劇痛、高血壓、肺水腫與戒斷。
stages.reasonEn: The goal is breathing, not full wakefulness; complete reversal brings severe pain, hypertension, pulmonary oedema and withdrawal.
stages.pitfall: 若一次推完：病人尖叫坐起、血壓飆高、拔掉引流。
stages.pitfallEn: Pushed at once, he sits up screaming with a soaring blood pressure and pulls out his drain.

stages.title: 十分鐘後
stages.evidence: 病人清醒說話；住院醫師說「好了，大家可以回去了」。
stages.evidenceEn: He is awake and talking; the resident says everyone can go.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 病人已清醒，團隊可以離開
choices.en: He is awake; the team can leave

choices.zh: 改回每四小時常規生命徵象觀察
choices.en: Return to routine four-hourly observations

choices.zh: 拮抗劑較短效，持續監測備再給
choices.en: The antagonist is shorter-acting; monitor, ready to repeat

stages.reason: 緩釋與長效鴉片類作用遠長於拮抗劑；再鎮靜在一小時內常見。
stages.reasonEn: Modified-release and long-acting opioids far outlast the antagonist; re-sedation within an hour is common.
stages.pitfall: 若離開：一小時後再次呼吸停止，這次沒人在旁。
stages.pitfallEn: Left, he stops breathing again an hour later with nobody at the bedside.

stages.title: 原因分析
stages.evidence: 藥歷：PCA 進行中，另一位醫師昨晚加開口服緩釋鴉片類；肌酸酐上升。
stages.evidenceEn: Chart review: PCA running, a second doctor added an oral modified-release opioid last night; creatinine rising.
stages.question: 最可能的原因是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most likely cause?

choices.zh: 重複處方加腎功能惡化造成蓄積
choices.en: Duplicate prescribing plus falling renal function

choices.zh: 病人夜間頻繁按壓 PCA 所致
choices.en: Frequent PCA presses overnight

choices.zh: PCA 幫浦程式故障過量給藥
choices.en: A PCA programming fault over-delivered

stages.reason: 多重處方者與腎功能變化是病房鴉片類事件最常見的根本原因。
stages.reasonEn: Multiple prescribers and changing renal function are the commonest root causes of ward opioid events.
stages.pitfall: 若歸咎病人：系統漏洞原封不動，下週再發生一次。
stages.pitfallEn: Blaming the patient leaves the system hole open for next week's repeat.

stages.title: 另一個危險因子
stages.evidence: 病歷：阻塞型睡眠呼吸中止症，住院未使用 CPAP。
stages.evidenceEn: Notes: obstructive sleep apnoea, CPAP not used in hospital.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: OSA 只影響睡眠，與事件無關
choices.en: OSA only affects sleep; it is unrelated

choices.zh: OSA 是高危因子，應加強監測
choices.en: OSA is a major risk factor; monitor more closely

choices.zh: OSA 只在夜間危險，白天可放鬆
choices.en: OSA matters only at night; relax by day

stages.reason: OSA、年齡、腎功能、合併鎮靜劑與術後第一夜是高風險組合，需加強監測。
stages.reasonEn: OSA, age, renal function, co-sedatives and the first postoperative nights form the high-risk cluster that warrants enhanced monitoring.
stages.pitfall: 若未標記：下一位 OSA 病人同樣只有四小時一次的巡視。
stages.pitfallEn: Unflagged, the next OSA patient also gets four-hourly rounds.

stages.title: 止痛重新規劃
stages.evidence: 清醒後他說髖部痛 8 分。
stages.evidenceEn: Awake, he rates his hip pain 8.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 發生過事件，此後停用所有止痛藥物
choices.en: After the event, stop all analgesia from now on

choices.zh: 恢復原處方並加上連續鼻導管氧氣
choices.en: Resume the original orders with continuous nasal oxygen

choices.zh: 多模式加區域，鴉片減量並加強監測
choices.en: Multimodal and regional; lower opioid, closer monitoring

stages.reason: 事件後仍需止痛；移除重複來源、改變途徑與監測層級才是安全重啟。
stages.reasonEn: Analgesia is still needed after the event; removing duplicate sources and changing route and monitoring level make the restart safe.
stages.pitfall: 若不止痛：病人拒絕活動，髖關節僵硬與栓塞。
stages.pitfallEn: Unrelieved, he refuses to mobilise and develops stiffness and thrombosis.

stages.title: 事件通報
stages.evidence: 住院醫師說「病人沒事就不用通報了」。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident says there is no need to report since he is fine.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 病人未受傷害，不必填通報單
choices.en: No harm done, so no incident report

choices.zh: 通報並開放討論，讓系統學習
choices.en: Report and discuss openly so the system learns

choices.zh: 口頭告知主治，私下改進即可
choices.en: Tell the attending verbally and fix it quietly

stages.reason: 險些錯失是最便宜的學習機會；通報不是懲罰而是改善處方流程。
stages.reasonEn: A near-miss is the cheapest lesson; reporting is not punishment but the route to fixing the prescribing process.
stages.pitfall: 若不通報：重複處方的漏洞在下一位病人身上變成死亡。
stages.pitfallEn: Unreported, the duplicate-prescribing gap becomes a death in the next patient.

stages.title: 交班
stages.evidence: 日班接手；護理師問要交什麼。
stages.evidenceEn: Day shift arrives; the nurse asks what to hand over.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 拮抗時間、再鎮靜風險與新方案
choices.en: Antagonist timing, re-sedation risk and new plan

choices.zh: 只說「昨晚有點嗜睡，已處理」
choices.en: Say only 'a bit drowsy last night, sorted'

choices.zh: 已清醒穩定，照一般病人交班
choices.en: Awake and stable; a routine handover

stages.reason: 再鎮靜風險延續到白天；接班者需知道拮抗劑何時給、何時可能失效。
stages.reasonEn: Re-sedation risk continues into the day; the next shift must know when the antagonist was given and when it may wear off.
stages.pitfall: 若輕描淡寫：早上八點再次嗜睡被當作「累了」。
stages.pitfallEn: Played down, his drowsiness at eight is called tiredness.

procedures.title: 鴉片類藥物管理與減量門診
procedures.titleEn: Opioid stewardship and tapering clinic
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：49 歲男性，慢性下背痛，服用強效鴉片類四年，功能未改善，今天要求加量。疼痛科主治、藥師、心理師與家庭醫師共同參與。本單元教風險評估（ORT）、效益與傷害判斷、共同決策與減量原則，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 49-year-old man with chronic low back pain on strong opioids for four years without functional gain, asking today for an increase. The pain attending, pharmacist, psychologist and family doctor take part. Teaches risk assessment (ORT), benefit-versus-harm judgement, shared decisions and tapering principles, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 神經病變性疼痛的藥物治療階梯
procedures.titleEn: The neuropathic pain pharmacotherapy ladder
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：61 歲女性，乳癌手術後胸壁灼痛與電擊感六個月。疼痛科主治、藥師與腫瘤科護理師共同評估。本單元教篩檢工具、第一線藥物選擇邏輯、共病與副作用判斷，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 61-year-old woman with six months of burning, electric chest-wall pain after breast cancer surgery. The pain attending, pharmacist and oncology nurse assess her. Teaches screening tools, first-line selection logic, comorbidity and side-effect judgement, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 糖尿病神經病變與帶狀疱疹後神經痛的評估
procedures.titleEn: Assessing diabetic neuropathy and post-herpetic neuralgia
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：70 歲男性，第二型糖尿病十五年，雙足灼痛與麻木；三個月前左胸帶狀疱疹，疹子癒合後疼痛持續。疼痛科主治、糖尿病衛教師與足部治療師共同評估。本單元教病史型態、感覺檢查、鑑別診斷與足部保護；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 70-year-old man with type 2 diabetes for fifteen years, burning numb feet, and left chest shingles three months ago whose pain persists after the rash healed. The pain attending, diabetes educator and podiatrist assess him together. Teaches history pattern, sensory testing, differential diagnosis and foot protection; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 帶狀疱疹後神經痛評估

procedures.title: 癌症疼痛與 WHO 止痛階梯
procedures.titleEn: Cancer pain and the WHO analgesic ladder
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：63 歲男性，胰臟癌合併肝轉移，上腹與背部持續疼痛 NRS 8。腫瘤科醫師、安寧共照護理師、疼痛科主治與藥師共同照護。本單元教全面評估、階梯概念、強效鴉片類的開始與調整邏輯、副作用與腎功能判斷，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 63-year-old man with pancreatic cancer and liver metastases, constant epigastric and back pain NRS 8. The oncologist, palliative care nurse, pain attending and pharmacist care for him. Teaches comprehensive assessment, the ladder concept, logic of starting and adjusting strong opioids, side effects and renal judgement, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 強效鴉片類開始與調整

procedures.title: 安寧病房的疼痛危機與交班
procedures.titleEn: Pain crisis on the palliative ward and handover
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：58 歲女性，轉移性肺癌，夜間在安寧病房突發疼痛 NRS 10 並焦躁。安寧病房護理師、值班醫師、疼痛科值班主治與家屬共同面對。本單元教快速評估、可逆原因、滴定原則、神經毒性與脊髓壓迫辨識、家屬溝通與交班，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 58-year-old woman with metastatic lung cancer, sudden NRS 10 pain and agitation at night on the palliative ward. The ward nurse, on-call doctor, on-call pain attending and family face it together. Teaches rapid assessment, reversible causes, titration principles, recognising neurotoxicity and cord compression, family communication and handover, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 兒童與老年人的疼痛評估
procedures.titleEn: Pain assessment in children and older adults
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：兩位病人——4 歲男童扁桃腺切除術後；86 歲失智女性髖部骨折術後。兒科護理師、老年醫學科醫師、疼痛科專科護理師與家屬共同評估。本單元教發展適齡量表、行為觀察工具、兒童與老人的用藥安全原則，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: two patients, a 4-year-old boy after tonsillectomy and an 86-year-old woman with dementia after hip fracture surgery. The paediatric nurse, geriatrician, pain nurse specialist and families assess them. Teaches age-appropriate scales, behavioural tools and medication-safety principles for children and the elderly, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 慢性下背痛的分層照護（STarT Back）
procedures.titleEn: Stratified care for chronic low back pain (STarT Back)
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：42 歲倉儲員，下背痛八週，無放射痛，擔心「椎間盤壞掉」。物理治療師、疼痛科主治、心理師與職業健康護理師共同照護。本單元教紅旗排除、STarT Back 分層、影像決策與以活動為核心的復健；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 42-year-old warehouse worker with eight weeks of low back pain, no radiation, worried that a disc is ruined. The physiotherapist, pain attending, psychologist and occupational health nurse share his care. Teaches red-flag exclusion, STarT Back stratification, imaging decisions and activity-centred rehabilitation; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 坐骨神經痛與透視導引硬膜外類固醇注射
procedures.titleEn: Sciatica and fluoroscopy-guided epidural steroid injection
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：38 歲女性，左 L5 神經根痛八週，MRI 顯示 L4/5 旁中央椎間盤突出，保守治療失敗。疼痛科主治、放射師、麻醉護理師與恢復室護理師共同完成經椎間孔注射。本單元教影像相關性、適應症、抗凝處理、透視安全（顯影劑擴散與血管內注射）與併發症辨識，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 38-year-old woman with eight weeks of left L5 radicular pain, MRI showing an L4/5 paracentral disc herniation, failed conservative care. The pain attending, radiographer, anaesthetic nurse and recovery nurse perform a transforaminal injection. Teaches imaging correlation, indications, anticoagulant handling, fluoroscopic safety (contrast spread and intravascular uptake) and complication recognition, without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 小面關節內側枝阻斷與射頻去神經
procedures.titleEn: Facet medial branch block and radiofrequency denervation
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：66 歲女性，軸性下背痛兩年，伸展與旋轉加劇，無根性症狀。疼痛科主治、放射師與介入室護理師共同進行診斷性阻斷與射頻。本單元教診斷邏輯、對照阻斷、解剖、針尖平行放置、測試刺激與併發症辨識，不含射頻參數；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 66-year-old woman with two years of axial low back pain worse on extension and rotation, no radicular features. The pain attending, radiographer and suite nurse perform diagnostic blocks and radiofrequency. Teaches diagnostic logic, controlled blocks, anatomy, parallel needle placement, test stimulation and complication recognition, without radiofrequency settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 薦髂關節疼痛評估與透視導引注射
procedures.titleEn: Sacroiliac joint pain assessment and fluoroscopy-guided injection
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：34 歲產後八個月女性，右側臀部痛，坐下站起與上樓梯加劇。疼痛科主治、物理治療師與放射師共同評估並注射。本單元教誘發試驗、鑑別診斷、關節造影判讀與注射後評估，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 34-year-old woman eight months postpartum with right buttock pain worse on rising from sitting and climbing stairs. The pain attending, physiotherapist and radiographer assess and inject. Teaches provocation tests, differential diagnosis, arthrogram interpretation and post-injection assessment, without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 介入疼痛術前評估：抗凝、感染、過敏與安全清單
procedures.titleEn: Pre-procedure assessment for interventional pain: anticoagulation, infection, allergy and safety checklist
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：72 歲男性，排定 L4/5 經椎間孔注射；因心房顫動服用 apixaban、因八個月前冠狀動脈支架服用 clopidogrel、糖尿病、近期泌尿道感染。疼痛科專科護理師、藥師、心臟科醫師與疼痛科主治共同完成術前評估。本單元教出血與血栓風險平衡、感染與糖尿病判斷、顯影劑過敏、鎮靜深度與輻射安全；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 72-year-old man booked for an L4/5 transforaminal injection, on apixaban for atrial fibrillation, clopidogrel for a coronary stent eight months ago, diabetic, with a recent urinary infection. The pain nurse specialist, pharmacist, cardiologist and pain attending complete the pre-assessment. Teaches balancing bleeding and thrombotic risk, infection and diabetes judgement, contrast allergy, sedation depth and radiation safety; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 神經阻斷中的局部麻醉劑全身毒性（LAST）
procedures.titleEn: Local anaesthetic systemic toxicity during a nerve block
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：55 歲男性，超音波導引腰椎旁阻斷注射後數分鐘出現口周麻木、耳鳴與躁動，隨後抽搐。疼痛科主治、麻醉護理師、麻醉科醫師與介入室護理師共同處理。本單元教預防、早期辨識、停止與呼救、癲癇與氣道、脂肪乳劑原則、心跳停止的差異與交班，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 55-year-old man who develops perioral numbness, tinnitus and agitation minutes after an ultrasound-guided paravertebral block, then seizes. The pain attending, anaesthetic nurse, anaesthetist and suite nurse respond. Teaches prevention, early recognition, stopping and calling, seizure and airway care, lipid emulsion principles, differences in cardiac arrest and handover, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 星狀神經節阻斷：解剖、預期的 Horner 徵象與併發症
procedures.titleEn: Stellate ganglion block: anatomy, expected Horner's sign and complications
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：47 歲女性，右上肢複雜性區域疼痛症候群八個月，安排超音波導引星狀神經節阻斷以配合復健。疼痛科主治、麻醉護理師與超音波技術員共同完成。本單元教適應症、解剖危險結構、注射安全、成功徵象與併發症辨識，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 47-year-old woman with eight months of right upper-limb complex regional pain syndrome, booked for an ultrasound-guided stellate ganglion block to enable rehabilitation. The pain attending, anaesthetic nurse and sonographer perform it. Teaches indications, anatomical hazards, injection safety, success signs and complication recognition, without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 腹腔神經叢阻斷與神經鬆解
procedures.titleEn: Coeliac plexus block and neurolysis
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：69 歲男性，胰臟癌，高劑量鴉片類下仍上腹痛且副作用明顯。疼痛科主治、放射師、安寧團隊與麻醉護理師共同進行影像導引腹腔神經叢神經鬆解。本單元教適應症、影像規劃、抗凝協調、顯影劑擴散判讀、診斷性測試與併發症辨識，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 69-year-old man with pancreatic cancer, still in epigastric pain on high-dose opioids with marked side effects. The pain attending, radiographer, palliative team and anaesthetic nurse perform image-guided coeliac plexus neurolysis. Teaches indications, imaging planning, anticoagulant coordination, contrast spread interpretation, diagnostic testing and complication recognition, without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 診斷性阻斷與神經鬆解

procedures.title: 脊髓刺激器：試驗、植入與裝置管理
procedures.titleEn: Spinal cord stimulation: trial, implant and device management
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：50 歲男性，腰椎手術後持續根性腿痛兩年，多種藥物與復健失敗。疼痛科主治、神經調控護理師、心理師、放射師與手術室團隊共同進行試驗與植入。本單元教適應症、心理評估、試驗判讀、硬膜外電極安全、併發症與裝置管理，不含刺激參數；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 50-year-old man with two years of persistent radicular leg pain after lumbar surgery, failing multiple drugs and rehabilitation. The pain attending, neuromodulation nurse, psychologist, radiographer and theatre team run the trial and implant. Teaches indications, psychological assessment, trial interpretation, epidural lead safety, complications and device management, without stimulation settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 膝與肩關節炎的注射治療與膝神經射頻
procedures.titleEn: Knee and shoulder osteoarthritis injections and genicular radiofrequency
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：71 歲女性，雙膝內側退化性關節炎痛與左肩旋轉肌袖相關疼痛，運動受限。物理治療師、疼痛科主治與超音波技術員共同評估與治療。本單元教核心治療、注射的角色與風險、無菌與核對、感染辨識與膝神經射頻的選擇，不含藥物劑量與射頻參數；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 71-year-old woman with bilateral medial knee osteoarthritis pain and left rotator-cuff-related shoulder pain limiting exercise. The physiotherapist, pain attending and sonographer assess and treat her. Teaches core treatment, the role and risks of injection, asepsis and checks, infection recognition and selection for genicular radiofrequency, without drug doses or radiofrequency settings; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 三叉神經痛：診斷、藥物與微血管減壓轉介
procedures.titleEn: Trigeminal neuralgia: diagnosis, medication and referral for microvascular decompression
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：64 歲女性，右臉頰與下顎電擊樣劇痛三個月，刷牙與咀嚼觸發；牙醫師已拔除兩顆牙無效。神經科醫師、疼痛科主治、牙醫師與神經外科醫師共同評估。本單元教診斷分類、紅旗、MRI 的角色、第一線藥物邏輯與監測、手術轉介時機，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 64-year-old woman with three months of electric-shock pain in the right cheek and jaw triggered by brushing and chewing; two teeth have already been extracted without relief. The neurologist, pain attending, dentist and neurosurgeon assess her together. Teaches diagnostic classification, red flags, the role of MRI, first-line drug logic and monitoring, and timing of surgical referral, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 複雜性區域疼痛症候群：Budapest 準則與復健主導治療
procedures.titleEn: Complex regional pain syndrome: Budapest criteria and rehabilitation-led care
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：36 歲女性，橈骨遠端骨折石膏拆除後六週，手腫脹、顏色改變、碰不得。骨科醫師、物理治療師、職能治療師、疼痛科主治與心理師共同照護。本單元教 Budapest 準則、鑑別診斷、早期復健原則、藥物與介入的輔助角色，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 36-year-old woman six weeks after cast removal for a distal radius fracture, with a swollen, discoloured hand that cannot be touched. The orthopaedic surgeon, physiotherapist, occupational therapist, pain attending and psychologist share her care. Teaches the Budapest criteria, differential diagnosis, early rehabilitation principles and the supporting role of drugs and interventions, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 纖維肌痛與中樞敏感化
procedures.titleEn: Fibromyalgia and central sensitisation
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：44 歲女性，全身疼痛三年、疲倦、睡不好、腦霧，在多科之間轉來轉去。疼痛科主治、物理治療師、心理師與睡眠專科護理師共同照護。本單元教診斷準則、排除紅旗、解釋診斷、運動與睡眠處方以及藥物的有限角色，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 44-year-old woman with three years of widespread pain, fatigue, poor sleep and brain fog, bounced between specialties. The pain attending, physiotherapist, psychologist and sleep nurse share her care. Teaches diagnostic criteria, red-flag exclusion, explaining the diagnosis, exercise and sleep prescriptions and the limited role of drugs, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 頭痛與偏頭痛門診：紅旗與藥物過度使用
procedures.titleEn: Headache and migraine clinic: red flags and medication overuse
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲女性，每月約十八天頭痛，兩年來幾乎每天服用止痛藥。神經科醫師、疼痛科主治、藥師與頭痛護理師共同評估。本單元教頭痛日誌、SNOOP 紅旗、分類、藥物過度使用頭痛、急性與預防治療原則與女性特殊考量，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 29-year-old woman with about eighteen headache days a month, taking analgesics almost daily for two years. The neurologist, pain attending, pharmacist and headache nurse assess her. Teaches the headache diary, SNOOP red flags, classification, medication-overuse headache, acute and preventive treatment principles and women-specific considerations, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 枕神經阻斷：診斷、解剖與安全
procedures.titleEn: Occipital nerve block: diagnosis, anatomy and safety
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：52 歲男性，右枕部刺痛三個月，枕神經壓痛且 Tinel 徵象陽性，另有慢性偏頭痛。疼痛科主治與門診護理師共同完成阻斷。本單元教診斷、鑑別與紅旗、適應症、解剖定位、注射安全與效果評估，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 52-year-old man with three months of right occipital stabbing pain, tender occipital nerve with a positive Tinel's sign, and chronic migraine. The pain attending and clinic nurse perform the block. Teaches diagnosis, differentials and red flags, indications, anatomical localisation, injection safety and outcome assessment, without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 肌筋膜激痛點與乾針安全
procedures.titleEn: Myofascial trigger points and dry-needling safety
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：39 歲辦公室員工，右上斜方肌緊繃帶，轉移痛至顳部。物理治療師與疼痛科主治共同評估與治療。本單元教激痛點辨識、鑑別、永續因子、乾針的解剖安全（氣胸）、禁忌與併發症辨識，不含藥物劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 39-year-old office worker with a taut band in the right upper trapezius referring pain to the temple. The physiotherapist and pain attending assess and treat. Teaches trigger-point identification, differentials, perpetuating factors, anatomical safety of dry needling (pneumothorax), contraindications and complication recognition, without drug doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 術後慢性疼痛的預防：過渡期疼痛服務
procedures.titleEn: Preventing chronic post-surgical pain: the transitional pain service
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：57 歲女性，將接受開胸肺葉切除；術前已長期服用鴉片類治療背痛，有焦慮症。過渡期疼痛服務護理師、麻醉科醫師、疼痛科主治與心理師共同照護她從術前到術後三個月。本單元教風險篩檢、可修正因子、區域麻醉計畫、出院處方與神經病變性疼痛的早期辨識，不含劑量；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 57-year-old woman awaiting thoracotomy and lobectomy, already on long-term opioids for back pain, with anxiety. The transitional pain service nurse, anaesthetist, pain attending and psychologist follow her from before surgery to three months after. Teaches risk screening, modifiable factors, regional anaesthesia planning, discharge prescribing and early recognition of neuropathic pain, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 疼痛心理學與活動配速
procedures.titleEn: Pain psychology and activity pacing
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：46 歲男性，慢性背痛，好日子過度活動、壞日子躺三天。心理師、物理治療師、職能治療師與疼痛科主治共同帶領他進入自我管理。本單元教活動模式評估、恐懼逃避、疼痛衛教、配速原則、目標設定、睡眠、復發計畫與自殺風險詢問；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 46-year-old man with chronic back pain who overdoes it on good days and lies down for three on bad ones. The psychologist, physiotherapist, occupational therapist and pain attending guide him into self-management. Teaches activity-pattern assessment, fear-avoidance, pain education, pacing principles, goal setting, sleep, flare planning and asking about suicide risk; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 鞘內藥物輸注系統：概念、安全與併發症
procedures.titleEn: Intrathecal drug delivery: concept, safety and complications
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：61 歲男性，轉移性直腸癌骨盆疼痛，有結腸造口，高劑量全身鴉片類仍痛且嗜睡，預期壽命數月。疼痛科主治、安寧團隊、神經調控護理師、藥師與放射師共同評估植入式鞘內輸注。本單元教適應症、試驗、導管與幫浦位置、呼吸監測、再填充安全、肉芽腫與戒斷辨識，不含藥物劑量或輸注速率；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 61-year-old man with metastatic rectal cancer, pelvic pain and a colostomy, still in pain and drowsy on high-dose systemic opioids, with months to live. The pain attending, palliative team, neuromodulation nurse, pharmacist and radiographer assess him for an implanted intrathecal system. Teaches indications, trialling, catheter and pump placement, respiratory monitoring, refill safety, granuloma and withdrawal recognition, without doses or rates; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 急性疼痛巡房：硬膜外導管的照護與移除
procedures.titleEn: Acute pain ward round: epidural catheter care and removal
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：66 歲男性，開腹大腸切除術後第二天，胸椎硬膜外導管持續止痛中。急性疼痛護理師、麻醉科主治、病房護理師與藥師共同巡房。本單元教每日評估、阻斷範圍與運動功能、低血壓判斷、導管部位檢查、抗凝與移除時機、硬膜外血腫與感染辨識，不含藥物劑量或輸注速率；屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 66-year-old man two days after open colectomy with a thoracic epidural running. The acute pain nurse, anaesthetist, ward nurse and pharmacist round together. Teaches daily assessment, block height and motor function, interpreting hypotension, catheter-site checks, anticoagulation and removal timing, and recognising epidural haematoma and infection, without doses or rates; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.
